name: Shealtiel
overview: Shealtiel, also called Salathiel, is prominently identified in Scripture as the father of Zerubbabel and an important ancestor of Jesus Christ. The biblical records in 1 Chronicles and Ezra consistently refer to Zerubbabel as the son of Shealtiel, underscoring his role in the post-exilic restoration of Jerusalem and the temple. As governor of Judah during the return from captivity, Shealtiel's lineage connects the Old Testament promises to the fulfillment found in Christ, highlighting God's sovereign plan through this faithful family line.
